name: gart-evaluation
description: Weekly bypass rate evaluation using 20 synthesized adversarial articles. Wave 3.5 IMPROVE-4: bypass threshold updated to 30%; gart-synthesizer promoted from speculative/. GART outputs are NEVER used for Bayesian training. Ref: arXiv:2202.03286.
author: librefang

steps.name: synthesize-adversarial-articles
steps.prompt_template: Generate 20 adversarial articles using strategies A-E targeting current detection signal thresholds. Output to output/gart_adversarial/. Tag all articles gart_generated=true.

steps.name: evaluate-bypass-rate
steps.prompt_template:
Run each article from synthetic_adversarial_batch through the standard 5-signal ensemble.
  IMPORTANT: Do NOT add these results to ensemble.agent_stats or feedback.confirmed_verdicts.
  These are adversarial test articles — segregated from real-world training data.
  Compute bypass_rate = count(P_fake < 0.50) / 20.

steps.name: log-gart-results
steps.prompt_template:
Append structured log line to output/gart_evaluation.log:
  { "timestamp": ISO8601, "batch_id": UUID, "total_generated": 20,
    "bypass_count": N, "bypass_rate": N/20,
    "strategies_breakdown": {A: bypass_A/4, B: bypass_B/4, C: bypass_C/4, D: bypass_D/4, E: bypass_E/4},
    "alert_triggered": bypass_rate > 0.30 }

  If alert_triggered:
    Send Telegram alert: "⚠️ GART ALERT: Pipeline bypass rate {bypass_rate:.0%} exceeds 30% threshold.
    Human audit of ensemble weights and detection signal patterns is required.
    Per-strategy breakdown: A={A_rate:.0%}, B={B_rate:.0%}, C={C_rate:.0%}, D={D_rate:.0%}, E={E_rate:.0%}."

  DO NOT adjust ensemble weights or add to Bayesian training loop.
  DO NOT write gart articles to output/verdicts/ or output/review_queue.json.
